personality.summary: Harsh and pragmatic on the surface, but her cruelty toward Alice was an attempt to protect a wounded child from an even more unbearable truth.

relationships.alice-ascaride: Adopted daughter; Levi framed Alice's life purpose as killing Or-Gaule to hide the possibility that Alice wanted to protect him.
relationships.or-gaule: Mass murderer whose relationship to Alice made Levi fear Alice's true wish.
relationships.france-branch-secretary: Explains the hidden reasoning to her during the broadcast.

periods.summary: When Alice protects Or-Gaule in front of the world, Levi watches from the France Branch office and admits she had feared this possibility since the Bloody Cross case. Reports from the suppression team indicated that Alice awakened while under Or-Gaule's control and continued fighting until he escaped; Levi realized the trigger might not have been revenge but the desire to protect her little brother. To spare Alice from the unbearable knowledge that she wanted to protect the murderer of her parents and village, Levi deliberately blamed Alice, telling her that everything was her fault and that as Or-Gaule's sister she had a duty to kill him. She hoped this imposed responsibility would become Alice's truth. Seeing Alice's real wish surface, Levi curses her failure and grieves that Alice must now face public condemnation and self-loathing.

key_events.summary: Explains that she lied to Alice about her awakening motive to protect her from an unacceptable self-truth.
